maddeler.e:
نصطخب (form VIII)
# نَصْطَخِبُ (naṣṭaḵibu) /nasˤ.tˤa.xi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# نُصْطَخَبُ (nuṣṭaḵabu) /nusˤ.tˤa.xa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# نَصْطَخِبَ (naṣṭaḵiba) /nasˤ.tˤa.xi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# نُصْطَخَبَ (nuṣṭaḵaba) /nusˤ.tˤa.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
